claims.natural_statement: For E:Y^2+Y=X^3 over C and every complex Enriques surface S, the correspondence image A in H^1(E,F_2) is either zero or all of H^1(E,F_2). The automorphism (x,y) maps to (zeta_3*x,y) preserves A and cyclically permutes the three nonzero classes. Thus any integral-Hodge failure for this E already implies the full defect (Z/2)^2; maximality is not an independent strengthening.

After a finite dyadic DVR extension B containing pi, kappa and zeta_3 with pi^2=2 and kappa^3=2, the group schemes G_(pi,pi) and G_(kappa,kappa^2) have isomorphic geometric generic fibers Z/2 and geometric special fibers alpha_2. For E:Y^2+Y=X^3, Hom_B(G_(pi,pi),E[2])=0, whereas Hom_B(G_(kappa,kappa^2),E[2]) consists of zero and the three maps t maps to -zeta_3^j*s. Over the algebraic closure k of the residue field, Hom_k(alpha_2,E_k[2]) is (k,+), via t maps to c*s. Thus neither geometric fiber Hom-vanishing detects the accepted fixed-model obstruction. Allowed finite-flat maps are not asserted to be cycle-realizable.

Over a finite dyadic extension with v(2)=1, explicit good models give nonzero two-torsion formal-parameter valuations E:(1/3,1/3,1/3), F:(1/2,1/4,1/4), and B:(2/3,1/6,1/6), with the marked b having valuation 2/3. No substantive original contribution is established under the publication bar. Equations (6)-(8) of classification.md identify the two degree-two pullback images with the same L_s via the graph of the 2-torsion gluing.
